summary: Vylor Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its Form 10 registration statement, tied to its separation from Corteva, Inc., was declared effective by the SEC on September 24, 2026. Corteva holders of record as of that date will receive one Vylor share for every Corteva share held, distributed before 9:30 a.m. New York time on October 1, 2026. Vylor common stock is expected to begin NYSE trading under VYLR on that date. The final information statement, dated September 24, 2026, is attached as Exhibit 99.1. Watch distribution mechanics and any condition waivers.
